text:
When measuring the emissions from a radioactive rock brought into the laboratory, a teacher
mentions that background radiation must be taken into account.
What is this background radiation?
A
infra-red radiation from warm objects in the laboratory
B
infra-red radiation from the Sun
C
ionising radiation from the radioactive rock brought into the laboratory
D
ionising radiation in the laboratory when the radioactive rock is not present

options.label: A
options.text: infra-red radiation from warm objects in the laboratory

options.label: C
options.text: ionising radiation from the radioactive rock brought into the laboratory

options.label: D
options.text: ionising radiation in the laboratory when the radioactive rock is not present
